mapper.sql: quotations.id AS id, quotations.type AS `type`, quotations.quotation_date AS `date`, quotations.quotation_code AS code, quotations.company_id AS companyId, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT((SELECT order_code FROM orders WHERE id = order_quotations.order_id AND status > 0) SEPARATOR ', ') FROM order_quotations WHERE order_quotations.quotation_id = quotations.id) AS soCode, companies.name AS companyName, companies.business_number AS companyTelephone, companies.address AS companyAddress, companies.website AS companyWebsite, IFNULL(companies.vat_number, '') AS companyVat, quotations.customer_id AS organizationId, customers.name AS organizationName, customers.customer_code AS organizationCode, customers.address AS organizationAddress, customers.main_number AS organizationTelephone, quotations.currency_center_id AS currencyId, currency_centers.name AS currencyName, currency_centers.symbol AS currencySymbol, quotations.customer_contact_id AS organizationContactId, customer_contacts.contact_name AS organizationContactName, customer_contacts.contact_telephone AS organizationContactTelephone, quotations.price_type_id AS priceTypeId, price_types.name AS priceTypeName, quotations.note AS note, quotations.total_amount AS subTotal, (quotations.total_amount - IFNULL(quotations.discount, 0) + IFNULL(quotations.total_vat, 0)) AS totalAmount, quotations.vat_setting_id AS vatId, vat_settings.name AS vatName, IFNULL(quotations.total_vat, 0) AS totalVat, IFNULL(quotations.vat_percent, 0) AS vatPercent, IFNULL(quotations.discount, 0) AS discountAmount, IFNULL(quotations.discount_percent, 0) AS discountPercent, IFNULL(quotations.margin_percent, 0) AS marginPercent, quotations.is_close AS isClose, quotations.is_approve AS isApprove, quotations.is_none_vat AS isNoneVat, quotations.share_user AS shareUserIds, quotations.share_except_user AS shareExceptUserIds, quotations.created AS created, COALESCE((SELECT name FROM employees WHERE user_id = quotations.created_by), CONCAT(users.first_name, ' ', users.last_name)) AS createdBy, quotations.modified AS modified, CONCAT(editor.first_name, ' ', editor.last_name) AS modifiedBy, quotations.status AS status, (quotations.created_by = #{userId}) AS isAllowShare, quotations.share_save_option AS shareSaveOption, quotations.share_option AS shareOption, quotations.page_row AS page, quotations.page_amount AS itemPerPage

FROM quotations LEFT JOIN customers ON customers.id = quotations.customer_id LEFT JOIN currency_centers ON currency_centers.id = quotations.currency_center_id LEFT JOIN companies ON companies.id = quotations.company_id LEFT JOIN customer_contacts ON customer_contacts.id = quotations.customer_contact_id LEFT JOIN price_types ON price_types.id = quotations.price_type_id LEFT JOIN vat_settings ON vat_settings.id = quotations.vat_setting_id LEFT JOIN users ON users.id = quotations.created_by LEFT JOIN users AS editor ON users.id = quotations.modified_by
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(quotations.id) FROM quotations INNER JOIN customers ON customers.id = quotations.customer_id LEFT JOIN customer_contacts ON customer_contacts.id = quotations.customer_contact_id

SELECT
WHERE quotations.status >= 0 AND quotations.id = #{id} AND quotations.company_id IN (SELECT company_id FROM user_companies WHERE user_id = #{userId}) GROUP BY quotations.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO quotations ( type, company_id, quotation_date, customer_id, customer_contact_id, currency_center_id, price_type_id, note, total_vat, vat_percent, vat_setting_id, vat_calculate, discount, discount_percent, total_amount, margin_percent, share_save_option, share_option, share_user, share_except_user, is_apply, is_approve, is_none_vat, created, created_by, edited, edited_by, modified, modified_by ) VALUES ( #{quotation.type}, #{quotation.companyId}, #{quotation.date}, #{quotation.organizationId}, #{quotation.organizationContactId}, #{quotation.currencyId}, #{quotation.priceTypeId}, #{quotation.note}, #{quotation.totalVat}, #{quotation.vatPercent}, #{quotation.vatSettingId}, #{quotation.vatCalculate}, #{quotation.discountAmount}, #{quotation.discountPercent}, #{quotation.totalAmount}, #{quotation.marginPercent}, #{quotation.shareSaveOption}, #{quotation.shareOption}, #{quotation.shareUser}, #{quotation.shareExceptUser}, #{quotation.isApply}, #{quotation.isApproved}, #{quotation.isNoneVat}, #{quotation.created}, #{quotation.createdBy}, #{quotation.edited}, #{quotation.editedBy}, #{quotation.modified}, #{quotation.modifiedBy} )

INSERT INTO quotation_details ( quotation_id, break_name, product_id, qty, conversion, qty_uom_id, discount_id, discount_amount, discount_percent, unit_cost, unit_price, total_price, is_break ) VALUES ( #{detail.quotationId}, #{detail.itemName}, #{detail.itemId}, #{detail.qty}, #{detail.conversion}, #{detail.uomId}, #{detail.discountId}, #{detail.discountAmount}, #{detail.discountPercent}, #{detail.unitCost}, #{detail.unitPrice}, #{detail.totalPrice}, #{detail.isBreak} )

INSERT INTO quotation_services ( quotation_id, service_id, qty, conversion, discount_id, discount_amount, discount_percent, unit_price, total_price ) VALUES ( #{service.quotationId}, #{service.itemId}, #{service.qty}, #{service.conversion}, #{service.discountId}, #{service.discountAmount}, #{service.discountPercent}, #{service.unitPrice}, #{service.totalPrice} );

INSERT INTO quotation_miscs ( quotation_id, description, qty, qty_uom_id, conversion, discount_id, discount_amount, discount_percent, unit_price, total_price ) VALUES ( #{misc.quotationId}, #{misc.itemName}, #{misc.qty}, #{misc.uomId}, #{misc.conversion}, #{misc.discountId}, #{misc.discountAmount}, #{misc.discountPercent}, #{misc.unitPrice}, #{misc.totalPrice} );
mapper.select: ( SELECT 1 AS `type`, quotation_details.id AS id, quotation_details.quotation_id AS quotationId, quotation_details.product_id AS itemId, products.name AS itemName, products.description AS description, products.code AS sku, products.barcode AS upc, products.photo AS productPhotoUrl, products.photo_name AS productPhotoName, products.spec AS spec, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(pgroups.name SEPARATOR ', ') FROM pgroups WHERE pgroups.is_active = 1 AND pgroups.id IN (SELECT pgroup_id FROM product_pgroups WHERE product_pgroups.product_id = products.id) ) AS itemBrand, quotation_details.qty AS qty, IFNULL(products.small_val_uom,1) / IFNULL(quotation_details.conversion, 1) AS conversion, quotation_details.qty_uom_id AS uomId, uoms.name AS uomName, uoms.abbr AS uomAbbr, quotation_details.discount_amount AS discountAmount, products.default_cost AS unitCost, products.unit_cost AS estimateCost, quotation_details.unit_price AS unitPrice, quotation_details.total_price AS totalPrice FROM quotation_details LEFT JOIN products ON products.id = quotation_details.product_id LEFT JOIN uoms ON uoms.id = quotation_details.qty_uom_id WHERE quotation_details.quotation_id = #{quotationId} AND quotation_details.is_break = 0 ) UNION ALL ( SELECT 2 AS `type`, quotation_services.id AS id, quotation_services.quotation_id AS quotationId, quotation_services.service_id AS itemId, services.name AS itemName, services.description AS description, services.sku AS sku, services.sku AS upc, NULL AS productPhotoUrl, NULL AS productPhotoName, services.description AS spec, NULL AS itemBrand, quotation_services.qty AS qty, 1 AS conversion, services.uom_id AS uomId, uoms.name AS uomName, uoms.abbr AS uomAbbr, quotation_services.discount_amount AS discountAmount, 0 AS unitCost, NULL AS estimateCost, quotation_services.unit_price AS unitPrice, quotation_services.total_price AS totalPrice FROM quotation_services LEFT JOIN services ON services.id = quotation_services.service_id LEFT JOIN uoms ON uoms.id = services.uom_id WHERE quotation_services.quotation_id = #{quotationId} ) UNION ALL ( SELECT 3 AS `type`, quotation_miscs.id AS id, quotation_miscs.quotation_id AS quotationId, quotation_miscs.id AS itemId, quotation_miscs.description AS itemName, NULL AS description, NULL AS sku, NULL AS upc, NULL AS productPhotoUrl, NULL AS productPhotoName, NULL AS spec, NULL AS itemBrand, quotation_miscs.qty AS qty, 1 AS conversion, quotation_miscs.qty_uom_id AS uomId, uoms.name AS uomName, uoms.abbr AS uomAbbr, quotation_miscs.discount_amount AS discountAmount, 0 AS unitCost, NULL AS estimateCost, quotation_miscs.unit_price AS unitPrice, quotation_miscs.total_price AS totalPrice FROM quotation_miscs LEFT JOIN uoms ON uoms.id = quotation_miscs.qty_uom_id WHERE quotation_miscs.quotation_id = #{quotationId} ) UNION ALL ( SELECT 4 AS `type`, quotation_details.id AS id, quotation_details.quotation_id AS quotationId, quotation_details.id AS itemId, quotation_details.break_name AS itemName, NULL AS description, NULL AS sku, NULL AS upc, NULL AS qty, NULL AS productPhotoUrl, NULL AS productPhotoName, NULL AS spec, NULL AS itemBrand, NULL AS conversion, NULL AS uomId, NULL AS uomName, NULL AS uomAbbr, quotation_details.discount_amount AS discountAmount, NULL AS unitCost, NULL AS estimateCost, NULL AS unitPrice, NULL AS totalPrice FROM quotation_details WHERE quotation_details.quotation_id = #{quotationId} AND quotation_details.is_break = 1 ) ORDER BY id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE crm_quotation_status_percents SET indicator_first = #{request.red}, indicator_second = #{request.yellow}, indicator_third = #{request.green} WHERE id = 1
mapper.select: SELECT indicator_first AS red, indicator_second AS yellow, indicator_third AS green FROM crm_quotation_status_percents WHERE id = 1
mapper.update: UPDATE quotations SET share_option = #{shareOption}, share_save_option = #{shareSaveOption} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT quotations.created AS created, quotations.created_by AS createdBy FROM quotations WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT crm_quotation_status_infors.id AS id, crm_quotation_status_infors.expected AS expected, crm_quotation_status_infors.expected_week AS expectedWeek, crm_quotation_status_infors.expected_month AS expectedMonth, crm_quotation_status.id AS status, crm_quotation_status.name AS statusName, customer_lead_divisions.title AS division, crm_quotation_status_infors.description AS description, DATE(crm_quotation_status_infors.created) AS `date`, CASE WHEN users.sex = 'Male' THEN CONCAT('Mr. ', users.first_name, ' ', users.last_name) WHEN users.sex = 'Female' THEN CONCAT('Mrs. ', users.first_name, ' ', users.last_name) ELSE CONCAT(users.first_name, ' ', users.last_name) END AS createdBy FROM crm_quotation_status_infors INNER JOIN crm_quotation_status ON crm_quotation_status.id = crm_quotation_status_infors.crm_quotation_status_id AND crm_quotation_status.is_active = 1 INNER JOIN customer_lead_divisions ON customer_lead_divisions.id = crm_quotation_status_infors.devision_id INNER JOIN users ON users.id = crm_quotation_status_infors.created_by WHERE crm_quotation_status_infors.quotation_id = #{quotationId}
ORDER BY crm_quotation_status_infors.id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT crm_quotation_status_infro_details.crm_quotation_status_reason_id AS id, crm_quotation_status_reasons.name AS name FROM crm_quotation_status_infro_details INNER JOIN crm_quotation_status_reasons ON crm_quotation_status_reasons.id = crm_quotation_status_infro_details.crm_quotation_status_reason_id WHERE crm_quotation_status_infro_details.crm_quotaion_status_infor_id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO crm_quotation_status_infors ( quotation_id, devision_id, crm_quotation_status_id, description, need_name, expected, expected_week, expected_month, created, created_by ) VALUES ( #{statusInformation.quotationId}, #{statusInformation.divisionId}, #{statusInformation.quotationStatusId}, #{statusInformation.description}, #{statusInformation.needName}, #{statusInformation.expectedPercent}, #{statusInformation.expectedWeek}, #{statusInformation.expectedMonth}, NOW(), #{statusInformation.createdBy} );
mapper.select: SELECT id AS id, CONCAT(last_name, ' ', first_name) AS name FROM users WHERE FIND_IN_SET(id, #{userIds})

SELECT q.quotation_code AS code, q.quotation_date AS `date`, COALESCE(u.abbr, 'Packet') AS uomAbbr, qd.unit_price AS unitPrice, products.name AS productName, products.code AS sku, products.barcode AS upc, products.photo AS productPhotoUrl, products.photo_name AS productPhotoName, products.spec AS spec FROM quotation_details qd INNER JOIN products ON products.id = qd.product_id INNER JOIN quotations q ON qd.quotation_id = q.id LEFT JOIN uoms u ON qd.qty_uom_id = u.id WHERE qd.product_id = #{productId} AND q.status = 1 ORDER BY q.quotation_date DESC
